notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, left-edge fixed-canopy master. Session 48 applied the same deterministic style-correction pipeline used for the right-edge master to this binary: source v001 canvas is 1120x1574 with alpha>=32 bbox (219,460)-(894,1071), including 10,482 sub-alpha-8 dust pixels and a baked ground-contact shadow under the wheels. Correction: alpha cleanup keeps only a Gaussian-smoothed alpha>=200 core plus a 4px Euclidean dilation (the raw alpha channel is grainy - +/-10-20 between neighbouring pixels even mid-gradient - so the smoothing pass was needed here to avoid a jagged threshold boundary; the right-edge master's cleaner alpha didn't need it, but the smoothed version was verified to reproduce that master's result bit-for-bit before use). Result: dust 10,482->0 outside the true silhouette (1,587 remaining are legitimate edge antialiasing, verified visually), contact shadow removed, alpha>=32 bbox becomes (219,460)-(894,1058) - a real ~13px shrink at the bottom, because this master's baked shadow blends continuously into the wheel's own contact shadow with no clean boundary; the removed region is the diffuse shadow gradient, not cart structure (verified visually - full wheel, tire, rim spokes, casters all intact). Style flattening: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering (sp=18, sr=45) + light bilateral + PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06 - same parameters as the right master, for family consistency. Measured: Laplacian-std texture 65.2->46.0, greyscale-contrast std 55.0->40.5, mean HSV saturation 125->69. IMPORTANT: this record is style-correction only, not a placement approval. SESSION 51 (orientation validation): resolved the temporary_orientation_note flag inherited from v001/session45 ('orientation refinement may be required during runtime testing') and the answer is negative - this binary is NOT usable as a left-edge master as-is. Evidence: (1) alpha>=32 bbox comparison shows the right master's silhouette is 723x625 (226,431)-(949,1056) vs this binary's 675x611 (219,460)-(894,1071) - different proportions, so this is an independently rendered image, not a naive horizontal pixel-mirror of the right master (rules out the 'casual runtime mirror' failure mode). (2) But a visual side-by-side shows this binary has the SAME internal handedness as the right master: the service/display counter (glass case, vada-pav bowl, QR placard) sits on the LOW-x side of the canvas and the storage/handle/gas-cylinder structure sits on the HIGH-x side, in both images - it is not mirrored relative to the right master, just independently drawn from the same camera-left viewpoint. (3) The engine's own contract in edgePlacement() (game.js, EDGE_PROP_DEFS section) defines roadFacingX = visualBounds.x0 for edge:'right' and visualBounds.x1 for edge:'left' - i.e. a left master's road-facing/service structure is expected on the HIGH-x side of its own canvas, the opposite of what this binary has. (4) The correctly-authored comparison pair in this same family, mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_umbrella_open_cart_{left,right}_neutral_1x_v002.png, DOES show the expected opposite handedness (display case flips from image-right in the left master to image-left in the right master, gas cylinder and handle flip correspondingly) - confirming this is achievable and that the fixed-canopy left binary is the outlier. (5) The session45_export_manifest.json record for this file already flagged the risk pre-emptively: source_file 'image-gen-1(14).png' (a generic filename, unlike the right master's clean 'Isometric Mumbai Vada Pav Cart.png' source) with temporary_orientation_note 'Fixed-canopy left master is provisionally assigned from an approved source image; orientation refinement may be required during runtime testing.' CONCLUSION: if drawn unmirrored at the left edge (runtime mirroring is prohibited by design), this binary would present its storage/handle side toward the playable road and its service/display side toward the city - backwards. This is a genuine re-authoring/re-sourcing need, not a style-correction or measurement gap, and not fixable by flipping a scale sign at runtime. Blocked: no dimensions/anchor/footprint measurement pass, no EDGE_PROP_DEFS entry, no Test A/Test C for this binary until a true opposite-handedness left master is sourced (see the umbrella-cart pair for what a correct pair looks like). Superseded from mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_fixed_canopy_left_neutral_1x_v001, which is kept unmodified on disk for traceability and carries the same orientation defect (this binary only reprocessed style/alpha, never crop or composition).
